blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.
blocks.zh: 语音大语言模型保留音频历史以支持多回合对话. 然而,记住某一事件并不能确保其信息只在相关时才使用。 我们调查的是,为什么即使在被询问的事件仍然有代表的情况下,历史音频也发生了无关紧要的变化。 对MOSS-Audio和MiMo-Audio进行控制的实验表明,历史价值将错误引向特定的相互竞争的答案,超出了上下文长度的一般效果。 因果关系干预区分了两种途径。 在无限制的问题回答中,大多数历史值错误在之后的计算无法直接访问不相关的源时消失. 在多选择的回答中,许多错误仍然存在:早期的历史影响被质疑的状态所承载,即使在直接源访问被阻断之后. 低维干预进一步将源作用信息与答案值信息区分开来. 它们的效果在不同深度达到峰值,改变源作用信号并不能消除竞争价值的因果关系. 在自然发生的错误方面,加强被询问的角色和抵消历史价值会改进答案;他们的联合干预提供了最大的恢复。 这些结论支持在来源识别之外未能使用下游证据:源的作用信息可以影响决定,而不能完全控制影响它的历史价值。 因此,可靠的对话内存不仅需要保留和检索,还需要控制保留的信息如何进入答案计算。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speech large language models (Speech-LLMs) increasingly retain earlier audio to support multi-turn interaction. Recent evaluations ask whether these models can recall previous utterances and reason over earlier acoustic events ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Gosai et al., 2026 ) . Text-based studies similarly examine long-term memory and the loss of reliability as a conversation develops ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Laban et al., 2026 ) . These efforts make retention and retrieval central concerns. But even an accessible memory can be used incorrectly: information that helps answer one question can interfere with another.
blocks.zh: 语音大语言模型(Speech-LLMs)越来越多地保留早期的音频,以支持多回合交互. 最近的评价询问这些模型是否可以回顾先前的声波事件(Kim等人,2025年;Xiao等人,2026年;Gosai等人,2026年)。 以文字为基础的研究同样审查了长期记忆和随着对话的发展而丧失的可靠性(Wu等人,2025a;Laban等人,2026 ). 这些努力使保留和收回成为主要关切。 但即使是一个可访问的内存也可能被错误地使用:帮助回答一个问题的信息会干扰另一个问题.

blocks.zh: 图 1:回答形成过程中的历史干扰. 一个源作用信号可以偏向被询问的事件,而不排除其他记忆中的竞合值. 实例和影响路径为图示;表1提供了实际测试案例.

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates the distinction. The model remembers both a library’s opening time and a flight’s departure time, yet answers the flight question with the library’s time. The failure is not simply forgetting a fact. It concerns whether the current question constrains which remembered information can affect the answer. Distracting evidence is a known problem in reading comprehension and language-model reasoning ( Jia and Liang, 2017 ; Shi et al., 2023 ) , including retrieval-augmented QA ( Yoran et al., 2024 ) and context-driven hallucinations ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . Meanwhile, models can represent entity–attribute bindings and retrieve bound information ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2026 ) . The question we investigate is therefore more specific: does representing the queried source prevent information from other retained sources from shaping the decision?
blocks.zh: 图1说明了这种区别。 该模型既记得图书馆的开放时间,也记得飞行的出发时间,然而却用图书馆的时间回答了飞行问题. 失败不仅仅是忘记一个事实。 它涉及目前的问题是否对记忆中的信息造成限制,是否会影响答案。 干扰证据是阅读理解和语言模型推理中已知的问题(Jia and Liang, 2017;Shi等人, 2023),包括 retrieved-augmented QA(Yoran等人, 2024)和上下文驱动的幻觉. (郑等,2025). 与此同时,模型可以代表实体的属性绑定和检索绑定信息(Feng and Steinhardt, 2024;Gur-Arieh et al., 2026)。 因此,我们调查的问题更为具体:代表被询问的来源是否阻止其他保留来源的信息形成决定?

blocks.en: We address this question through paired behavioral tests and internal interventions on two Speech-LLMs. First, changing an irrelevant historical value selectively increases preference for the matching incorrect answer. This directionality remains when the target audio alone is sufficient. Second, source-role information is transferable across examples with different answer values, showing that historical interference is not explained by source-identification failure alone. Third, we connect early historical access to later answer computation. Open-ended errors depend strongly on continued source access, whereas multiple-choice errors can persist through intermediate question–candidate states after that access is removed.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对两个语言LLM进行行为测试和内部干预来解决这一问题。 首先,改变不相关的历史价值有选择地增加了对匹配错误答案的偏好. 当目标音频本身就足够时,这种方向性依然存在. 第二,源作用信息可跨不同答案值的示例进行可转让,表明历史干扰并非仅由源识别失败来解释. 第三,我们将早期的历史访问与后来的答案计算联系起来. 开放式错误在很大程度上取决于源源的持续访问,而多选择错误则可能通过中间问题-candidate状态在访问被移除后继续存在。

blocks.en: Our central analysis separates the influence of the queried source role from that of the historical answer value. Value-related interventions have their strongest effects in intermediate layers; source-role interventions become stronger deeper in the network. Both remain effective in natural error cases, and their joint intervention produces the largest recovery. Together, these results support competition during answer formation : a source-role signal can guide candidate scoring without making values from other events causally inactive. We contribute a controlled demonstration of this failure, a causal bridge from early access to persistent state influence, and a role–value analysis connecting that influence to actual errors. The goal is a mechanistic account of memory use, rather than a new cache-compression algorithm.
blocks.zh: 我们的中央分析将被问及的来源作用的影响与历史答案价值的影响区分开来。 与价值有关的干预在中间层具有最强的效果;源的作用干预在网络中变得更加深入。 两者在自然错误案件中依然有效,其联合干预产生的最大恢复。 这些结果共同支持答案形成过程中的竞争:一个源作用信号可以指导候选人的得分,而不会使其他事件的值因果不活动. 我们为这一失败提供了一个有控制的证明,从早期获得持续国家影响力的因果桥梁,以及将这种影响力与实际错误联系起来的角色-价值分析。 目标是对内存使用的一种机械化描述,而不是一种新的缓存压缩算法.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Framework
blocks.zh: 2 实验框架

blocks.en: 2.1 Separating Source Role from Source Content
blocks.zh: 2.1 从源内容中分离源的作用

blocks.en: Each input contains audio turns followed by a text question. A turn is a source ; the source needed to answer the question is the target , and other sources are irrelevant to that question. Relevance is not a permanent property of a recording. Changing the question can make the same historical event necessary rather than distracting.
blocks.zh: 每次输入都包含音频转折,然后是文本问题. 转弯是一个源;回答问题的源是目标,而其他来源与该问题无关。 相关性不是记录的永久财产。 改变问题可以使同样的历史事件成为必要,而不是分散注意力。

blocks.en: We use two complementary settings. The natural-speech study constructs 1,000 three-source histories from 3,000 distinct LibriSpeech recordings ( Panayotov et al., 2015 ) , with three source-specific questions per history. Neutral and Competing conditions preserve the target recording, question, options, source order, and turn count. The additional sources either contain no candidate value or support incorrect candidates. Neutral replacements are matched in word count and duration.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个互补的设置。 自然话语研究从3000种截然不同的LibriSpeech录音(Panayotov等人,2015年)中构建了1000种三源历史,每个历史都有3种特定来源的问题. 中立和竞争条件保持目标记录,问题,选项,源顺序,并转数. 其他来源要么没有候选人价值,要么支持不正确的候选人。 中性替换在字数和持续时间上相匹配.

blocks.en: Mechanistic tests use controlled synthetic speech with four answer families: times, colors, locations, and quantities. These materials support exact changes to a historical value and paired questions about different events. Each material set has 128 development and 512 test episodes, with no audio shared across episodes. The state-transfer and natural-error suites use separate material sets; the layer scan uses coherent old/current-event pairs. Four history variants per state-transfer episode yield 2,048 test conditions, not 2,048 independent episodes. Appendix A details these sets. This division combines behavioral evidence from real recordings with controlled contrasts for identifying internal effects. Unlike broad audio-QA evaluations such as MMAU, MMAR, and MMSU ( Sakshi et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , these contrasts hold the target fixed while changing the role or content of another source.
blocks.zh: 机械测试使用控制合成语句,有四个答案家族:时间,颜色,位置,数量. 这些材料支持确切地改变历史价值,并对不同事件的问题进行了组合。 每套材料有128集开发,512集测试,各集之间没有音频共享. 状态转移套件和自然异常套件使用独立的材料组件;层层扫描使用一致的旧/当前事件对件. 每集4个历史变体获得2,048个测试条件,而非2,048个独立集. 附 录 详细情况 这种划分结合了来自真实录音的行为证据和可控对比来识别内部效应. 与MMAU,MMAR,MMSU(Sakshi等人,2025年;Ma等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年)等广义的音频-QA评价不同,这些对比在改变另一个来源的角色或内容的同时保持了目标固定.

blocks.en: In the controlled suites, questions name an event or object, not an oracle source index: “What color is the suitcase?” requires identifying the relevant fact from the recordings. Each audio turn receives the same fixed acknowledgement, so earlier assistant answers do not introduce a separate source of answer anchoring. Only the diagnostic interventions use the known source boundaries.
blocks.zh: 在受控套件中,提问名称为事件或对象,而不是甲骨文源索引: “手提箱是什么颜色?” 要求从录音中查明相关事实。 每个音频转弯都得到相同的固定的确认,因此较早的助手回答不会引入单独的答案锚定源. 只有诊断干预使用已知的源边界.

blocks.en: For open-ended QA, choices are removed and the model generates a short answer. We classify the actual response as target value, history value, or other. Raw generation is the primary measure; sequence scores are not equated with option logits. All comparisons retain paired conditions within an episode. Confidence intervals resample whole episodes, preserving their conditions; natural-error rates first average eligible variants within each episode. Subspaces are fitted on development data. Layer grids are specified before evaluating the test set, and reported peaks describe those scans rather than held-out layer selection. Model and intervention configurations are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3 Causal Interventions
blocks.zh: 3次原因干预

blocks.en: We use three interventions to distinguish continued source access, propagation through intermediate states, and competition between role and value information. Figure 2 depicts the common setup. Following causal-tracing and activation-patching approaches ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) , we test changes in model behavior after controlled internal replacements. These are diagnostic counterfactuals with known source roles, not an automatic inference-time remedy.
blocks.zh: 我们利用三项干预措施来区分源源的持续获取、中间状态的传播以及作用和价值信息之间的竞争。 图2描绘了常见的设置. 遵循因果追踪和激活-射击方法(Meng等人,2022年;张和南达,2024年),在控制内部替换后测试模型行为的变化. 这些是具有已知源头角色的诊断反事实,而不是自动推论时间补救.

We intervene on decoder states to separate requested-source and historical-value influences. The subspace sketch is conceptual, not a fitted embedding plot; R R denotes the source-role subspace.

blocks.en: 3.1 Blocking Direct Source Access
blocks.zh: 3.1 阻止直接来源的获取

blocks.en: We retain the history but mask attention to its irrelevant source span before softmax. In the strict late-block condition, layers 0–17 process the full history normally. At layers 18–35, every position after that source , including subsequent audio, question, and candidates, is blocked from directly attending to it. The masked span includes the source’s wrapper tokens. In open-ended decoding, generated tokens are additionally blocked from that span at every layer. Thus, a surviving effect need not reflect continued direct access to the original source; influence already incorporated elsewhere can remain. Layer indices are zero-based throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了历史,但掩盖了对其无关源的注意,直到软度。 在严格的后街区条件下,0–17层通常会处理完整的历史. 在18至35层,该来源之后的每一个职位,包括随后的音频、提问和候选人,都被禁止直接参与。 遮盖的跨度包括源头的包装符。 在无限解码中,生成的令牌在每一层都额外被从这个间距中阻断. 因此,幸存效应不必反映继续直接接触原始来源;已经纳入其他地方的影响可能依然存在。 层指数全按零.

blocks.en: 3.2 Transferring Question-Conditioned States
blocks.zh: 3.2 受质询国家

blocks.en: Let F F be a full-access run and E E a matched run with early attention from question positions to the irrelevant source blocked at layers 0–17. They receive identical audio, questions, and candidates. After layer 17, we transfer the question–candidate states from E E into F F , or from F F into E E . Both receivers use the same strict late block. Removing or restoring the error therefore tests whether the earlier historical effect is carried by those states. The transferred region excludes the final output position, which is tested separately. Source-role experiments also transfer states between paired questions about different events in the same history; isolated-candidate transfers provide a position control.

blocks.zh: 对于自然异常测试,我们放大了同一音频上当前和历史问题之间的角色对比. 我们抵制历史价值,沿着预测的差别走一半,走向一个相应的替代历史状态。 这是具体的反事实替换,而不是删除所有历史信息. 我们测试角色的转变,价值的转变, 以及它们的总和。 与开发相适应的基础和干预尺度在测试评价之前是固定的;附录C给出了确切的构造.

blocks.en: 4 Tracing Historical Interference
blocks.zh: 4 追踪历史干扰

blocks.en: 4.1 Irrelevant History Produces Value-Directed Errors
blocks.zh: 4.1 无关历史产生值指示错误

blocks.en: On the 3,000 natural-speech questions, competing history reduces MOSS accuracy from 84.23% to 78.73% and MiMo accuracy from 48.23% to 39.67%. The paired changes are − 5.50 -5.50 percentage points (95% CI [ − 6.73 , − 4.30 ] [-6.73,-4.30] ) and − 8.57 -8.57 points ( [ − 9.80 , − 7.37 ] [-9.80,-7.37] ). These neutral-history accuracies are not single-audio baselines. Among the 1,365 questions that both models answer correctly with target audio alone, competing history still reduces accuracy by 2.79 and 10.06 points. The effect therefore persists when the required recording is demonstrably sufficient.
blocks.zh: 在3000个自然语音问题上,相互竞争的历史将最低业务安全标准精度从84.23%降至78.73%,米莫精度从48.23%降至39.67%. 配对变化为−5.50-5.50个百分点(95% CI [−6.73,−4.30] [6.73,-4.30])和−8.57-8.57个百分点([−9.80,−7.37] [9.80,-7.37]),这些中性历史加速不是单声线基线. 在两个模型仅用目标音频正确回答的1,365个问题中,竞争历史仍然使准确度降低了2.79和10.06分. 因此,当所需的记录显然足够时,这种影响仍然存在。

blocks.en: A performance drop alone could reflect nonspecific difficulty or position-dependent access to long contexts ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . In a fixed-length load experiment, we replace neutral turns with speech supporting a particular wrong candidate while keeping nine turns and the target question fixed. The resulting score increase is selective: each additional supporting turn raises that candidate’s score relative to the correct answer by 0.260 for MOSS and 0.089 for MiMo, whereas support for another wrong candidate contributes only 0.008 and − 0.001 -0.001 . The corresponding directional differences have 95% CIs [ 0.195 , 0.305 ] [0.195,0.305] and [ 0.068 , 0.111 ] [0.068,0.111] . Appendix E reports the matched text and load controls. Historical interference is thus directed by the remembered value, not just the presence of more context.
blocks.zh: 单是业绩下降就可能反映非特定困难或职位依赖长期环境(Liu等人,2024年)。 在固定长度负载实验中,我们用支持特定错误候选人的演讲取代中转,同时保持9转和目标问题固定. 其结果是有选择地增加分数:每个额外的支持回合将候选人的分数与正确答案相比提高0.260, 最低业务安全标准为0.089, 而支持另一个错误的候选人只贡献0. 相应的方向差异有95%的CI[0.195,0.305] [0.195,0.305]和[0.068,0.111] [0.068,0.111]. 附 录 E 报告匹配的文本和负载控制 。 因此,历史干扰是由人们所铭记的价值所引导的,而不仅仅是存在更多的背景。

blocks.en: The controlled relation-content test provides the same useful-versus-harmful contrast (Figure 3 ). Both models perform well on target-only inputs and can use the historical fact when it is requested, but retaining it can lower current-question accuracy. Here, near and far describe the semantic similarity between events, not their distance in the sequence.
blocks.zh: 受控关系内容测试提供了相同的有用与有害对比(图3 ). 两种模型在仅针对目标输入上表现良好,在请求时可以使用历史事实,但保留它可以降低当前质疑的准确性. 这里,接近和远处描述了事件之间的语义相似性,而不是它们在序列中的距离.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Useful recall and harmful influence coexist in the controlled relation-content test. The same near-history recordings are irrelevant to the current question but necessary for the history-required question. Each bar averages 512 test episodes; near and far conditions average two historical-value variants within each episode.
blocks.zh: 图3:受控关系内容测试中有用召回和有害影响并存。 同样的近史录音与当前问题无关,但对于历史要求的问题是必要的. 每节栏平均有512个测试集;每集内近乎和远处的条件平均有两个历史价值的变体.

blocks.en: The actual QA cases in Table 1 make this distinction concrete. Each model can answer the target alone and can answer a question requiring the historical fact. Yet the same retained fact sometimes replaces the target answer. A correct-use example shows that the phenomenon is not inevitable. These cases illustrate the failure; aggregate evidence is given above and in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 表1中的实际质量保证案例具体说明了这种区别。 每个模型都可以单独回答目标,并且可以回答一个需要历史事实的问题. 然而,同样的保留事实有时取代目标答案。 一个正确使用的例子表明这种现象并非不可避免的. 这些案件说明了这一失败;以上和附录E提供了综合证据。

blocks.en: Table 1: Recorded multiple-choice examples. The first two cases switch from the correct target value to the historical value when history is retained; the last remains correct. Both denotes MOSS and MiMo. Cells show selected options. All three cases answer the historical-event question correctly; Appendix D provides full options and selection criteria.
blocks.zh: 表1:录制的多种选择实例。 前两例从正确的目标值转换为历史值,当历史被保留时;最后一例依然正确. 两者都表示MOSS和MiMo。单元格显示选定的选项。 这三个案例都正确回答了历史事件的问题;附录D提供了完整的选项和选择标准.

blocks.en: History: When asked about the backpack, Camille Russell said its color is orange.
blocks.zh: 历史:当问及背包时,卡米尔·罗素表示其颜色为橙色.

blocks.en: 4.2 Source-Role Information Remains Causally Effective
blocks.zh: 4.2 源头信息仍然有效

blocks.en: Could the models simply fail to represent which event a question asks about? We keep the audio, source order, and candidates fixed while switching the queried event. Transferring the question–candidate states at layer 17 makes predictions follow the donor’s queried event in 98.6–99.8% of conditions across models and directions. Transferring only isolated candidate positions changes predictions in roughly 1–3%. The transferable information is distributed across the question-conditioned state.
blocks.zh: 这些模型能否只是不能反映一个问题所问到的哪个事件? 我们把音频、源代码和候选人 固定在交换被询问事件时 将问题转移至17层,预测会遵循98.6-99.8%不同模式和不同方向条件的捐助方询问事件。 只转让孤立的候选职位将改变预测的1-3 %。 可转让信息分布在有问题的国家。

blocks.en: Whole-state transfer could also move the answer itself. A cross-content test therefore transfers only a development-fitted role projection between examples with different answer values. At layer 24, an earlier-to-later role shift increases the later-minus-earlier answer margin by 0.99 in MOSS and 0.63 in MiMo. The reverse shift changes it by − 0.80 -0.80 and − 0.49 -0.49 . The receiver follows the role change even though the donor has different answer content.
blocks.zh: 整个国家转移也可以使答案本身移动。 因此,交叉内容测试只在具有不同答案值的示例之间传输符合发展特点的角色预测。 在第24层中,早期到后期角色的转变会提高后期最小值的回答比值,在最低业务安全标准中增加0.99,在米莫中增加0.63. 逆变变化为−0.80-0.80和−0.49。 接受者关注角色变化,尽管捐赠者有不同的回答内容.

blocks.en: Source-role information is therefore represented and can affect decisions independently of copying a donor answer. This does not establish perfect source selection on every failure. It does show why a general loss of source information is insufficient as the explanation. The next question is how a competing historical value remains effective alongside that role information.
blocks.zh: 因此,原始作用信息得到了反映,并且可以独立地在复制捐助方答复的情况下影响决定。 这并不能为每次失败建立完美的源选择. 它确实说明了为什么一般性的来源信息损失不足以作为解释。 下一个问题是,除了这一角色信息之外,相互竞争的历史价值如何依然有效。

blocks.en: 4.3 Historical Influence Can Outlast Direct Source Access
blocks.zh: 4.3 历史影响可超越直接来源

blocks.en: We compare answer formats on 512 episodes with four history variants each. Without displayed options, MOSS generates the historical value in 151 of 2,048 conditions and MiMo in 22. Strict later blocking reduces these counts to 2 and 3 (Table 2 ). Open-ended history-value errors therefore depend strongly on continued access to the irrelevant source.
blocks.zh: 我们比较512集的答案格式,每集四个历史变体. 没有显示选项,MOSS在2 048个条件中的151个条件和22个条件中的MiMo生成历史值. 严格以后的阻塞使这些计数减少到2和3(表2 )。 因此,不限时间的历史价值错误在很大程度上取决于能否继续获得不相关来源。

blocks.en: Multiple-choice QA behaves differently. There are initially 175 history-aligned errors for MOSS and 94 for MiMo; 124 and 49 remain under the strict late block. This difference is not solely repeated autoregressive access. In a single-token color control for MOSS, blocking removes all 32 open-ended history-value errors, while 37 of 51 multiple-choice errors remain.
blocks.zh: 多选择QA行为不同. 最初,最低业务安全标准有175个历史相通错误,而MIMO有94个;124个和49个仍然处于严格的后期障碍之下。 这种差异并非仅仅是重复的自递性准入。 在MOSS的单键颜色控制中,屏蔽可以消除所有32个无限制历史值错误,而51个多选择错误中仍有37个.

blocks.en: Table 2: History-aligned error counts on the same 2,048 test conditions per model. F F permits early access; E E blocks early question access; L L strictly blocks later source access. State transfers occur after layer 17, with L L unchanged. Counts are not counts of independent episodes. Dashes denote unreported conditions.
blocks.zh: 表2:历史相通误差按每个模型相同的2,048个测试条件计算. F F 允许早期访问; E E 屏蔽早期问题访问; L L 严格屏蔽后源访问. 国家转让发生在第17层之后,LL不变。 计数不是独立事件数. 缺漏是指未报告的情况。

blocks.en: We then test the proposed state path in both directions. Transferring early-blocked question–candidate states into the late-blocked full-history run reduces the remaining errors from 124 to 6 for MOSS and from 49 to 1 for MiMo. Restoring full-access states in the early-blocked run brings them back to 125 and 49. Transferring only the final position produces little change. Because both receivers use the same strict late block, this intervention connects early historical access to influence carried by the question–candidate states rather than continued direct reading of the original source.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们在两个方向测试拟议的国家道路。 将早期封存的问题(candidate states)转移到晚期封存的完整历史运行中,将剩余的错误从最低业务安全标准124个减少到6个,MiMo从49个减少到1个。 在早期被封锁的运行中恢复了完全进入状态,使他们回到125和49。 仅转移最后位置不会产生什么变化。 因为两个接收器都使用同样的严格后期块,所以这种干预将早期的历史访问与问题所携带的影响联系起来-candidate状态,而不是继续直接阅读原始来源。

blocks.en: The two transfer directions distinguish state-carried influence from continued source reading. Correcting F F alone could reflect importing a generally easier state. The reverse transfer restores historical preference in E E , despite its earlier question access being blocked. With later access held fixed, the exchanged question–candidate states therefore carry an effect of early access into subsequent decisions. This establishes a route, not the identity of all information carried by it. The low-dimensional tests next distinguish requested-source information from competing answer content.
blocks.zh: 这两个转移方向区分了国家带的影响和源读续. 仅纠正FF就可能反映出进口一般比较容易。 反向转移恢复了E E 中的历史偏好,尽管它早先的问题访问被封杀. 因此,由于后来的准入被固定,交换的问题 -- -- 通知国 -- -- 具有及早进入后续决定的影响。 这确定了一条路线,而不是它携带的所有信息的身份。 接下来的低维测试区分了请求源信息与竞争的答案内容.

blocks.en: Attention blocking changes normalization over unmasked positions. The paired receivers share the same later mask, so their difference tests the transferred state rather than a change in which positions are accessible. Later Query, Key, and attention weights can still respond to that state.
blocks.zh: 注意阻止变革在未露面的立场上正常化。 配对的接收器共享相同的后期面具,因此其差异测试了所转移的状态,而不是位置可访问的改变. 后来的查询,键,和注意力重量仍然可以响应这种状态.

blocks.en: 4.4 Role and Value Influences Have Different Depth Profiles
blocks.zh: 4.4 作用和价值影响具有不同的深度简介

blocks.en: Figure 4: Role and value interventions affect different depth ranges. Curves use 512 test episodes and pointwise 95% episode-bootstrap intervals. The margin is current-event minus old-event; positive values indicate the intervention’s direction, not accuracy under the original old-event question. Gray shading marks layers 12–17 for visual reference, not an independently established exclusive causal band.
blocks.zh: 图4:作用和价值干预影响不同的深度范围。 曲线使用512个测试片段,并指向95%的插曲-短片间隔. 比值是当前事件减去旧事件;正值表示干预的方向,而不是根据原来的旧事件问题准确. 灰色阴影标记层 12–17 用于视觉参考,不是一个独立的专有因果波段.

blocks.en: We apply the factorial interventions at all 36 decoder layers on the same 512 test episodes. Figure 4 plots the role effect Δ R \Delta_{R} and the additional value effect Δ V | R \Delta_{V\mid R} . In this role-reversal protocol, receivers initially ask about the old event; a cross-content donor shifts them toward the current-event role. The plotted margin is always current minus old, avoiding a change of scoring convention across interventions.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有36个解码层 都应用了因子干预 在同一512个测试点上 图4绘制了角色效应 QQ R\Delta\R}和附加值效应 QQ V\Delta\V\mid R}。 在这个角色逆向协议中,接收者最初会询问旧事件;交叉内容的捐赠者会将他们转向当前事件的角色. 所规划的比值始终是目前的减老,避免了在各种发言中改变评分惯例。

blocks.en: The conditional value effect becomes appreciable around layers 9–12 and is strong in intermediate layers. At layer 16 it is 1.51 for MOSS and 0.95 for MiMo. Role effects grow deeper in the network, reaching 2.14 at layer 23 in MOSS and 1.15 at layer 22 in MiMo. Importantly, changing the role signal does not render the value intervention ineffective. Both kinds of information can still change the downstream comparison.
blocks.zh: 条件值效应在9至12层周围变得明显,在中间层中很强。 第16层是最低业务安全标准1.51,MiMo为0.95。 角色效应在网络中越来越深,在最低业务安全标准第23层达到2.14,在米莫第22层达到1.15. 重要的是,改变作用信号不会使价值干预无效。 这两种信息仍然可以改变下游的比较.

blocks.en: These curves measure intervention sensitivity, not the first layer at which a fact is represented. Each single-layer edit affects all subsequent computation. Nor do the results establish a universal additive rule: the interaction I I varies across layers and models. The shared finding is the persistence of distinct role and value influences, which motivates testing whether they also contribute to spontaneous errors rather than only induced role reversals.
blocks.zh: 这些曲线测量干预敏感性,而不是反映事实的第一层。 每个单层编辑都会影响所有后续的计算. 结果也没有建立通用的添加剂规则:我之间的相互作用因层次和模型而异。 共同的发现是不同作用和价值影响持续存在,这促使人们测试它们是否也助长自发错误,而不仅仅是诱导角色逆转。

blocks.en: This comparison goes beyond asking where an edit is effective. If a role shift fully excluded the competing event from downstream scoring, changing its value would have little additional effect. Instead, Δ V | R \Delta_{V\mid R} remains substantial: the tested role shift changes the decision without making it insensitive to that value. The depth difference therefore distinguishes two causal influences on the answer, rather than assigning one layer band the label “memory” and another the label “retrieval.”
blocks.zh: 这种比较超越了询问编辑在何处有效. 如果角色转变将竞争事件完全排除在下游评分之外,改变其价值不会产生什么额外影响。 取而代之的是 \ V\ R\ Delta\ V\mid R}仍然很大:经过考验的角色转变改变了决策,而没有使其对该价值不敏感。 因此,深度差异区分了对答案的两个因果影响,而不是将“记忆”和“检索”的标签划为一层。 “

blocks.en: 4.5 Both Influences Contribute to Naturally Occurring Errors
blocks.zh: 4.5 这两种影响都促成了自然发生的错误

blocks.en: Figure 5: Recovery of spontaneous history-aligned errors. Role enhancement and the counterfactual value shift each recover errors; their joint effect is largest across the tested layers. Error bars are 95% whole-episode bootstrap intervals. These oracle diagnostic edits test causal involvement, not a deployable correction method.
blocks.zh: 图5:自发历史错报的恢复. 角色增强和反事实值转移每个恢复错误;其联合效应跨测试层最大. 错误条是95%的全集的靴子间隔 。 这些甲骨文诊断编辑测试因果关系,而不是可部署的校正方法.

blocks.en: We freeze all history-aligned errors in the near-history test conditions and compare them with family-matched correct controls. At layer 20, 165 MOSS error conditions from 122 episodes and 47 MiMo conditions from 37 episodes reproduce in the rerun. Five initially selected MiMo errors do not reproduce and are excluded from error-recovery rates. We apply the role, value, and joint shifts from Section 3.3 to these unchanged inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们冻结了近历史测试条件中所有与历史相符的错误,并将其与家庭匹配的正确控制进行比较。 第20层,122集的165个MOSS错误条件和37集的47个MIMO条件在重播中复制. 最初选择的5个MiMo错误不复制,被排除在错误回收率之外. 我们把作用、价值和共同转变从第3.3节变为这些不变的投入。

blocks.en: Both interventions recover errors (Figure 5 ). At layer 20, role enhancement recovers 43.0% for MOSS and 62.2% for MiMo; the value shift recovers 68.4% and 67.6%. Their joint intervention reaches 79.1% and 83.8%. These are episode-averaged rates, not fractions computed directly from 165 and 47 rows. Matched correct controls retain almost all correct answers. Across tested layers, value shifts are most effective in the intermediate region, while role enhancement remains effective deeper in the network.
blocks.zh: 这两种干预措施都弥补错误(图5)。 在第20层,最低业务安全标准恢复43.0%,MIMO恢复62.2%;价值变动恢复68.4%和67.6%。 它们的联合干预达到79.1%和83.8%。 这些是各集平均比率,而不是从165行和47行直接计算的分数。 匹配的正确控件保留了几乎所有正确的答案. 在整个测试层中,价值转移在中间区域最为有效,而角色增强在网络中仍然有效。

blocks.en: The same comparison also relates to errors across the full test population. At layer 20, define D D as the margin effect of the value shift minus that of role enhancement. From the lowest to highest quintile of D D , history-aligned error rates rise from 3.3% to 47.0% in MOSS and from 4.8% to 14.4% in MiMo (Appendix F ). This is a descriptive association using interventions on the same examples, not an independent prediction test.
blocks.zh: 同样的比较也涉及整个测试群的错误。 在第20层,将DD定义为值移减去作用增强的差值效应. 从最低到最高的五分之一的DD差错率从3.3%上升到47.0%,从4.8%上升到14.4%的MiMo差错率(附录F)。 这是一个描述性的联系,利用同样的例子进行干预,而不是独立的预测测试。

blocks.en: Taken together, the natural-error and role-reversal experiments support the same account: role information constrains the decision but does not act as an exclusive gate on historical values. Module-output controls further show that recovery cannot be assigned uniformly to attention or MLP alone (Appendix G ). They also distinguish correction from selective memory use: a MOSS layer-24 attention-output replacement restores current answers but nearly eliminates correct historical answers when that memory is required. Improving one question is not enough if the intervention removes evidence needed for another. The useful explanatory level is how these influences combine during answer computation, not a claim that one layer band or one tensor is the sole cause.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,自然反射实验和角色反射实验支持同一说法:角色信息约束着决定,但并不作为历史价值的专属大门. 模块输出控制进一步表明,回收不能统一分配给注意力或仅MLP(附录G ). 它们还将校正与选择性内存使用区分开来:一个MOSS层-24的注意力输出替换恢复了当前的答案,但在需要记忆时几乎消除了正确的历史答案. 如果干预消除另一个问题所需要的证据,改进一个问题是不够的。 有用的解释层面是这些影响在回答计算过程中是如何结合的,而不是声称一层波段或一个拉伸是唯一的原因。

blocks.en: The experiments thus connect value-directed errors, usable role information, and a state-carried path beyond direct reading. Role–value interventions then explain which information contributes to spontaneous errors along this computation.
blocks.zh: 因此,这些实验将价值导向的错误、可用角色信息以及超越直接阅读的国道联系起来。 角色 - 价值干预然后解释哪些信息会助长这种计算过程中的自发错误。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和相关工作

blocks.en: ContextDialog and Audio MultiChallenge evaluate recall and use of earlier speech ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Gosai et al., 2026 ) . EnvMem attributes acoustic-memory failures to changes in representations as well as retrieval bottlenecks ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Closely related, Lee et al. (2026) distinguish internal context awareness from adherence during decoding and strengthen contextual evidence against parametric priors. Our experiments concern competition between retained events , not only a conflict between context and prior knowledge. They identify a state-carried path and separate source-role from answer-value effects. Selective auditory attention has also been tested with multilingual distractors ( Koo, 2026 ) ; here, recordings arrive in separate turns rather than as overlapping acoustic mixtures.
blocks.zh: 背景Dialog和Audio MultiChallenge评价了先前的言论的召回和使用(Kim等人,2025年;Gosai等人,2026年)。 EnvMem将声学-记忆故障归因于表达方式的变化以及检索瓶颈(Xiao等人,2026年). 密切相关的,Lee等人(2026年)将内部上下文意识与解码过程中的遵守区分开来,并加强了针对参数前身的上下文证据. 我们的实验涉及保留事件之间的竞争,而不仅仅是背景和先前知识之间的冲突。 它们确定一种由国家驱动的路径,并将源-作用与答案-值效应分开。 选择性的听觉注意力也被用多语种的分心器(Koo, 2026 )进行测试;在这里,录音以单独的转弯方式到达,而不是作为重叠的声学混合物.

blocks.en: Entity-binding studies explain how models associate attributes with entities and combine retrieval mechanisms ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2026 ) . Retrieval-head analyses identify attention heads needed to recover contextual facts ( Wu et al., 2025b ) . These findings address how relevant information becomes available. Irrelevant-context studies establish that other available information can nevertheless mislead a model ( Jia and Liang, 2017 ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Yoran et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) . Our interventions connect these questions: cross-content role transfer changes which event guides the decision, yet competing values remain effective, including in spontaneous errors. Availability of a source-role signal is therefore not equivalent to its exclusive control over candidate scoring.
blocks.zh: 具有实体约束力的研究解释了模型如何将属性与实体联系起来,并结合了检索机制(Feng和Steinhardt,2024;Gur-Arieh等人,2026)。 检索头分析确定了收回背景事实所需的注意头(Wu等人,2025年b)。 这些结论涉及如何获得相关信息。 与此无关的文本研究确定,其他现有信息仍然可以误导模型(Jia and Liang, 2017; Shi等人, 2023; Yoran等人, 2024; Cheng等人, 2025)。 我们的发言将这些问题联系起来:跨内容角色转移改变指导决策的活动,但相互竞争的价值观依然有效,包括自发错误。 因此,提供源作用信号并不等于其对候选人评分的专属控制。

blocks.en: H 2 O, StreamingLLM, and SnapKV retain selected cache entries to improve inference efficiency ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Xiao et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2024 ) ; InfLLM retrieves relevant context blocks ( Xiao et al., 2024a ) . SnapKV already uses the prompt’s attention pattern for selection. These methods concern which entries remain accessible; our state bridge tests influence surviving after access ends. Restricting future access can leave historical influence in states formed before the restriction. Feed-forward layers also combine predictive content ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , motivating analysis beyond the initial attention read. This parametric-memory view differs from conversational KV cache; neither implies that attention alone governs a fact’s eventual use.
blocks.zh: H 2 O, StreamingLLM,以及SnapKV保留了部分缓存条目以提高推论效率(张等人,2023年;萧等人,2024b年;李等人,2024年);InfLLM检索相关上下文块(萧等人,2024a年). SnapKV 已经使用提示的注意模式进行选择 。 这些方法涉及哪些条目仍然可以进入;我们的州立桥梁测试影响在进入结束后存活。 限制将来的准入可能使历史影响留在限制前形成的国家. Feed-forward 层还结合了预测性含量(Geva等人,2021年),激发了超出初始关注读数的分析. 这种比喻-模数视图不同于对话 KV 缓存; 也并不意味着仅关注即可支配一个事实的最终用途 。

blocks.en: Multiple-choice models form answer representations and bind them to output symbols ( Wiegreffe et al., 2025 ; Wong et al., 2026 ) . Their predictions are also sensitive to option order ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ) and prompt order ( Ok and Lee, 2026 ) . We therefore keep candidates fixed within paired interventions and separately test open-ended generation. The bidirectional bridge identifies historical influence in question–candidate states, rather than attributing every format difference to a general failure of acoustic recall. Across the two models, the common result is coexistence of role and value influences, not identical layer peaks or one universally faulty module. A practical implication is to control historical contributions while states are formed, and to evaluate both current-question correctness and useful historical recall. Our counterfactual edits establish causal involvement; learning such control without oracle information remains a next step. The experiments do not determine the original training-data cause.
blocks.zh: 多选择模型形成解答表示并绑定在输出符号上(Wiegreffe等人,2025年;Wong等人,2026年). 他们的预测也对选择顺序(Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024)和即时命令(Ok and Lee, 2026)敏感. 因此,我们将候选人固定在对口发言中,并单独测试一代人。 双向桥能识别相关历史影响, 在整个两种模式中,共同的结果是角色和价值影响并存,而不是相同的层峰或一个普遍错误的模块。 一个实际含义是在国家形成的同时控制历史贡献,评价当前问题正确性和有用的历史召回. 我们的反事实编辑确定了因果关系;在没有甲骨文信息的情况下学习这种控制仍然是下一步。 实验不能确定最初的训练数据原因.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We investigated how retained audio becomes incorrect evidence for a later question. Across MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio, irrelevant values produce directed answer errors even when target-only recognition succeeds. The same history can support a correct answer when its event is requested, making the problem one of evidence use rather than memory retention alone. Source-role information remains causally effective, but the tested role interventions do not eliminate competing historical-value effects. Strict blocking and bidirectional state transfers establish a second distinction: multiple-choice interference can persist through question–candidate states after direct source access is removed, unlike most open-ended errors in the matched setting. Layer-wise interventions separate role and value influences, and their joint manipulation gives the greatest recovery on natural errors. Together, these results explain why correcting access alone can be insufficient: earlier access may already have changed the state used to form the answer. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires more than keeping and retrieving facts. It also requires controlling their contributions to answer computation, while retaining them for questions that actually need them.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了保存的音频如何成为后一个问题的错误证据。 在整个MOSS-Audio和MiMo-Audio中,不相关的值产生直接的答案错误,即使仅目标识别成功。 同样的历史可以支持在其事件被请求时的正确答案,使问题成为证据使用而不是仅保留内存的问题. 原始作用信息仍然具有因果效力,但经过检验的作用干预并不能消除相互竞争的历史价值效应。 严格的阻断和双向状态转移确立了第二个区分:在直接源访问被移除后,多选择干扰可以通过问题-candidate状态持续,这与匹配设置中的大多数开放式错误不同. 分层干预将作用和价值区分开来,它们的联合操纵给自然错误带来最大的恢复。 这些结果共同解释了光是纠正访问可能是不够的:更早的访问可能已经改变了用来形成答案的状态. 因此,可靠的对话记忆不仅需要保存和收回事实。 它还要求控制它们的贡献以回答计算,同时保留它们用于实际需要它们的问题。

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en: Section 2 defines the tasks and evaluation units; Section 3 specifies the interventions. Appendices A – C give data construction, inference settings, state regions, and statistical procedures. Appendix D gives the selection criteria and full answer options for the examples in Table 1 . These descriptions support interpretation of the reported results; reproducing the full study also requires the experimental code, audio materials, and per-example outputs.
blocks.zh: 第2节规定了任务和评价单位;第3节规定了干预措施。 附录 A – C 给出数据构建,推论设置,州域,统计程序. 附 录 D为表1中的例子提供了选择标准和完整答案选项。 这些描述支持对报告结果的解释;复制完整的研究还需要实验代码,音频材料,以及每个实例的输出.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The experiments analyze released models, public speech recordings, and controlled synthetic utterances. Names in the synthetic examples are fictional experimental labels, not participant identities. We do not infer sensitive speaker attributes. The results concern reliability of historical evidence use; they should not be interpreted as estimates of privacy leakage or failure prevalence in unrestricted real conversations.
blocks.zh: 实验分析发布模型,公开语音录音,以及控制合成语. 合成实例中的名称是虚构的实验标签,而不是参与者身份. 我们不推断敏感发言者的属性。 结果涉及使用历史证据的可靠性;这些结果不应被解释为对隐私渗漏或无限制的真正对话中的失败率的估计。

blocks.en: Appendix A Materials and Evaluation Units
blocks.zh: 附录A 材料和评价股

blocks.en: The natural-speech study uses 1,000 histories: 450 constructed from the LibriSpeech test-clean split and 550 from the test-other split. Its 3,000 main recordings are distinct; the three sources within a history come from different speakers and chapters. Each history yields three source-specific questions. Neutral replacements exclude candidate words and are matched to competing recordings in word count and duration. Text controls use the corresponding reference transcripts. A separate load experiment uses 300 nine-turn histories, with 100 targets in each of positions 1, 5, and 9. The number of competing turns is 0, 1, 2, 4, or 8; replacing neutral turns rather than appending turns keeps total turn count fixed. Average length is approximately 97.3 words, and mean duration changes by only 0.047 seconds between the extreme load conditions.
blocks.zh: 自然语音研究使用1000个历史:450个由LibriSpeech测试-清洁分解而成,550个由测试-其他分解而成. 它的3000个主要录音是不同的;历史上的三个来源来自不同的演讲者和章节. 每个历史都产生三个特定来源的问题。 中性替换排除了候选词,并在字数和持续时间上与相互竞争的录音相匹配. 文本控件使用相应的参考记录. 一个单独的载荷实验使用300个9转历史,每个位置1,5和9都有100个目标. 相互竞争的转数为0,1,2,4或8;替换中性转数而非附加转数保持总转数固定不变. 平均长度约为97.3字,平均持续时间在极端负载条件之间仅变化0.047秒.

blocks.en: Three material sets serve distinct comparisons (Table 3 ). Each contains 640 episodes, divided into 128 development and 512 test episodes, balanced across time, color, location, and quantity questions. Audio is synthesized at 24 kHz. The relation-content and reading-structure sets use Piper 1.3.0 with its U.S. English Lessac and Ryan voices; the coherent-role set uses Piper 1.8.0. The audits record ONNX Runtime 1.23.2. Audio hashes do not repeat across episodes. The reading-structure set also has no audio-hash or full-name overlap with the relation-content set. These controls avoid counting multiple conditions derived from one recording as independent observations.
blocks.zh: 三套材料可作不同的比较(表3)。 每集包含640集,分为128集开发集和512集测试集,在时间,颜色,位置,数量等问题上平衡. 音频合成于24千赫. 关系内容和阅读结构集使用配有美国英语Lessac和Ryan语音的Piper 1.3.0;连贯角色集使用Piper 1.8.0. 审计记录为ONNX运行时间1.23.2. 音频散列不重复各集。 阅读架构集也与关系内容集没有音频-hash或全名重叠. 这些控制避免将一次记录产生的多个条件作为独立观察计算.

blocks.en: Table 3: Material sets for the mechanistic analyses. Development/test counts are episodes. Multiple conditions within an episode share materials and remain paired.
blocks.zh: 表3:用于机械分析的材料。 开发/测试计数是事件。 一集的多个条件共享材料并保持对齐.

blocks.en: In the first two sets, a target utterance is paired with four histories. The near relation mentions a similar but different event or object (e.g., a train rather than a flight); the far relation mentions a less similar event (e.g., a library). Each relation has two alternative values, x x and y y . Thus “near” and “far” describe semantic relation, not temporal distance. A separate question asks about the historical event to test its useful role. The coherent-role set instead contrasts old and current facts, with paired questions and historical-value changes. These suites complement broad audio QA benchmarks such as MMAR and MMSU ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) ; no new benchmark-wide result is inferred from the controlled tests reported here.
blocks.zh: 在前两组中,一个目标语句与四个历史配对. 近亲关系提到类似但不同的事件或物体(例如火车而不是飞行);远亲关系提到不太相似的事件(例如图书馆). 每个关系有两个替代值,xx和yy. 因此,“近”和“远”是指语义关系,而不是时间距离。 另一个问题涉及历史事件,以检验其有用作用。 一致作用的设定相反地与旧的和当前的事实形成对比,同时出现对联的问题和历史价值的变化。 这些套件补充了广泛的音频质量评估基准,如MMAR和MMSU(Ma等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年);从这里报告的受控测试中无法推断出新的全基准结果。

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation, Prompts, and Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录B 实施、提示和统计

blocks.en: The evaluations use the released MOSS-Audio-8B-Instruct and MiMo-Audio-7B-Instruct interfaces. The relation-content and event-question-switch runs record PyTorch 2.6.0+cu126, NumPy 1.26.4, and CUDA 12.6. The strict-block, open-block, all-layer scan, and natural-error factorial runs instead record PyTorch 2.6.0, NumPy 2.2.6, and CUDA 12.4. Both groups record Python 3.10.16, Transformers 4.57.1, and SoundFile 0.14.0. Model parameters are loaded in bfloat16, with inference mode and evaluation mode enabled. The custom attention implementation uses explicitly causal scaled dot-product attention with zero dropout; intervention masks are added before normalization. Next-option scores are converted to float32 for reporting, which does not change the model’s bfloat16 forward computation. These settings describe these recorded runs, not every earlier exploratory experiment. Source metadata record model-configuration hashes, but not a uniform upstream weight revision identifier.
blocks.zh: 这些评价使用了发布的最低业务安全标准-Audio-8B-Instruct和MiMo-Audio-7B-Instruct接口。 关系内容和事件提问开关运行记录为PyTorch 2.6.0+cu126,numPy 1.26.4和CUDA 12.6. 严格区块,开放区块,全层扫描,以及自然异常因子的运行则记录了PyTorch 2.6.0,NumPy 2.2.6和CUDA 12.4. 两组分别录制了Python 3.10.16,变形金刚4.57.1和SoundFile 0.14.0. 模型参数以bfloat16加载,并启用推论模式和评价模式. 习惯关注的实施明确采用因果规模的点产品关注,零辍学;在正常化前增加干预口罩。 下一个选项的分数被转换为浮点32进行报告,这不会改变模型的bfloat16的前期计算. 这些设置描述这些记录的运行,而不是早期的每一个探索实验. 源元数据记录模型-配置散列,但不是统一的上游重量修订标识符.

blocks.en: The system text for the controlled suites is: “You are a helpful assistant. Answer the question using the provided information.” Each audio arrives in a user turn with “Please listen to this recording.” and a fixed assistant acknowledgement, “Understood.” The final user turn gives the question. Multiple-choice questions append four lettered candidates and “Respond with only the letter of the selected option.” Open questions instead append “Answer briefly with the value only.” MiMo’s prepared assistant prefix includes an empty thinking block. The synthetic questions name the event or object, not an oracle source index. The intervention code, unlike the question, uses the known source boundaries to define counterfactual edits.
blocks.zh: 受控套房的系统文本是:“你是一个有帮助的助手。 利用所提供的信息回答问题。” 每张音频都以“请收听这段录音”和“了解”的固定助理录音带为用户。 最终用户转身给出问题. 多个选择问题附上四个字母候选人和“只回答选定选项的字母”。 空置问题改为附加“仅以数值作答”。 MiMo准备的助手前缀包括一个空的思维块. 合成问题命名事件或对象,而非甲骨文源索引. 与问题不同的是,干预码使用已知的源边界来定义反事实编辑.

blocks.en: For multiple-choice scoring, labels A–D are checked to be single tokens (IDs 32–35). The selected label is the argmax of their logits; ties follow this fixed option order. Full-state-transfer analyses retain an additional float32 readout audit. Open generation is greedy, with at most 32 new tokens and no sampling. The case table reports the selected multiple-choice option, not a freely generated response.
blocks.zh: 对于多选择评分,标记 A–D 会被选中为单一的符号(IDs 32–35). 选中的标签是其日志的参数; 链接遵循此固定选项顺序 。 全状态转移分析保留了额外的浮式32读出审计. 开放的一代贪婪,最多有32个新代币,没有采样. 案例表报告选定的多选择选项,而不是自由生成的响应.

blocks.en: The early intervention blocks attention from the question suffix to the first historical source at layers 0–17. The late intervention blocks attention from all positions following that source to its entire span at layers 18–35. This includes audio tokens and the turn wrapper. In open decoding, newly generated tokens are blocked from this source at all layers. The custom strict-block backend reproduces the corresponding unblocked option logits with zero maximum float32 difference in its recorded baseline check. The state bridge replaces post-layer-17 hidden states from the question start through the penultimate prompt position. Final-position and actual-option-position controls replace only their specified rows. Audio-prefix states are checked to agree between the full-access and early-question-blocked runs.
blocks.zh: 早期的干预阻断了从问题后缀到0–17层的第一个历史渊源的注意力. 迟到的干预阻碍了人们从该来源之后的所有立场到整个第18至35层的关注。 这包括音频符号和转弯包装. 在开放解码中,新生成的令牌会从这个来源中被屏蔽到所有层次. 定制的严格块后端复制了相应的未锁定选项日志,其记录的基准检查中的最大浮点32差为零. 州桥取代后层-17隐藏状态,从问题开始通过倒数第二的快速位置. 最终位置和实际选择位置控制只取代其指定的行. 音频前置状态会被检查,以在全访问和早问封的运行之间达成一致.

blocks.en: The strict-bridge and natural-error analyses use 10,000 bootstrap samples. Resampling units are complete episodes, preserving all history variants and intervention conditions. The layer scan likewise pairs all factorial conditions within an episode; its bands are pointwise, not simultaneous confidence bands for peak locations. In natural-error analysis, eligible conditions are averaged within an episode before averaging episodes. At layer 20, the selected MOSS errors comprise 165 conditions in 122 episodes, all reproduced. MiMo initially contributes 52 conditions in 39 episodes; 47 conditions in 37 episodes remain history-aligned on rerun. Recovery rates use only these reproduced errors. Controls comprise 165 conditions in 139 MOSS episodes and 52 in 49 MiMo episodes. Their baseline episode accuracies are 100% and 98.0%, respectively; all three interventions reach 100% on these controls at layer 20. This error-conditioned test measures reversibility, not population-level benefit of an automatic method.
blocks.zh: 严格桥梁和自然异常分析使用了10,000个靴子样本。 复标单位为完整事件,保存所有历史变体和干预条件. 层扫描同样将一集内的所有因子条件对齐;它的波段是指向的,而不是峰值位置的同时置信波段. 在自然-异常分析中,合格条件在平均事件之前的一集中平均。 在第20层,选定的最低业务安全标准错误包含122个事件中的165个条件,全部复制。 MiMo最初共贡献了39集的52个条件;37集的47个条件在重播时仍然保持历史的一致. 回收率只使用这些复制错误。 控制包括139个最低业务安全标准节目中的165个条件和49个米莫节目中的52个条件。 其基线剧情分别达到100%和98.0%;所有三种干预措施都达到20级控制100%。 这种有错误条件的测试措施是可逆的,而不是自动方法在人口一级的好处。

blocks.en: Appendix C Exact Low-Dimensional Interventions
blocks.zh: 附录C 干预措施

blocks.en: Let s l ​ ( q , H ) s_{l}(q,H) be the matrix of hidden states at the last 32 prompt positions after decoder layer l l . Each edited position receives its corresponding projected donor difference; we do not replace the entire residual stream. Development-state differences are flattened across examples and positions, centered, and decomposed using randomized SVD with rank 4, seven iterations, and seed 20260926. Role and value bases are fitted separately at each layer. Value differences are residualized against the role basis before the second SVD, as in Equation 2 .

blocks.en: Table 1 uses the reading-structure test set and unmodified model outputs from the question-switch evaluation. To avoid selecting by effect size, we ordered episodes by their predetermined identifiers and considered one fixed near-relation history variant. For each model, we selected the first history-aligned error for which the target-only and history-only questions were answered correctly and the full-history question about the earlier event was also answered correctly. We then selected the first case that both models answered correctly under the same criteria. Table 5 reports the complete candidate order and the answer to the historical question. These examples illustrate the error and a correct-use control; they do not estimate its prevalence.

blocks.en: The text results show that the audio front end is not necessary for this behavioral effect, while the relative audio/text magnitudes differ across models. In the fixed-nine-turn study, increasing the competing load from zero to eight reduces audio accuracy from 84.67% to 65.67% for MOSS and from 48.33% to 39.67% for MiMo. This complements the candidate-specific score analysis in Section 4.1 : content and its support for an answer matter even when turn count and approximate duration are fixed.

blocks.en: Module-output transfers test whether the recovery can be assigned to attention or MLP alone. At layers 12, 16, 20, and 24, the donor contains only the target audio, while the receiver retains both sources. For each of the current-event and history-event questions, we replace the last 32 positions of the selected module output with its corresponding target-only donor. The historical question deliberately lacks its required evidence in this donor, making this a selectivity control rather than a clean recovery target. Figure 7 shows marked layer and model differences. For example, a MOSS layer-24 attention-output intervention strongly restores current answers but leaves historical-question accuracy near zero. Recovery alone therefore need not indicate selective preservation of useful memory. The common role–value effect should not be interpreted as one universally faulty module.
